name: Tamsin Oddwater
role: Illusionist, head of the Oddwater Company
description:
The illusionist at the head of the Oddwater Company: a small, warm-faced gnome woman with wild silver curls under a violet velvet top hat and a coat lined with stars. On stage she is huge and warm; off it she is quick, plain and funny, like somebody's favourite aunt. She greets a town by name like an old friend she is slightly worried about, and asks a question and answers it herself before anyone else can.

She wants a full hall that gasps in the right places, and to know, at the door, which part each person will remember.
